evidence: Directly modifies src/index/txindex.cpp and src/index/txindex.h to lift the restriction against running txindex alongside pruning.
rationale: Resolves multiple long-standing feature requests (#10609, #12651, #16182, #35240) by allowing -txindex to operate on pruned nodes. Reviewers noted that running txindex on a pruned node is a 'huge improvement' that makes pruned nodes much more capable while drastically cutting storage requirements.
